chart.usage: Every Dualis chart is rebuilt from its data in this style. Two themes (Thierry 2026-11-09): 'dark' = Substack Notes and X, white data on the deep indigo ground; 'light' = website and report pages, indigo data on white. A chart with more than three series takes the chart-series palette in order.
rules: Rebuild every chart from its numbers (a CSV, a table, the filings). Never redraw a chart by reading values off an image.
Legend on top, left aligned. No chart border.
A value label on every bar and on the last point of each line.
An estimate period carries an E after its label (FY26E).
A source line under the chart: "Source: Company filings, Dualis Research."
Main series first colour, a second series as a line with dots on the right axis, a benchmark in the muted grey.
Bars have rounded 4px tops. Faint horizontal gridlines only, no vertical ones.
Green and red only for long and short data, never decoration.
Titles state the claim ("Margins are back at the 2019 level"), never the topic.

logos.usage: Mark in Dualis indigo on light grounds.
